title: Susan Gough says Gimbal is not a training video

tellings.quote: I asked Susan Goant and she told me it wasn't a training video.

plain: The Gimbal video, Navy footage of a strange object filmed by a fighter jet's targeting camera off Florida in 2015, is not a training video, according to a Pentagon spokesperson named Susan Gough. The UFO skeptic Mick West says he asked Gough directly, and she told him it was not a training video. It matters because it rules out one ordinary explanation for where the footage came from.
